mapper.select:
SELECT id, tunnel_code AS tunnelCode, tunnel_name AS tunnelName, tunnel_type AS tunnelType, stage, length_m AS lengthM, geo_desc AS geoDesc, status, start_date AS startDate, remark FROM prj_tunnel WHERE is_deleted = 0
ORDER BY id

SELECT id, tunnel_id AS tunnelId, section_code AS sectionCode, section_name AS sectionName, mileage_from AS mileageFrom, mileage_to AS mileageTo, geo_zone AS geoZone, stage, status, sort FROM prj_section WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND tunnel_id = #{tunnelId}
ORDER BY sort, id

SELECT p.id, p.point_code AS pointCode, p.point_name AS pointName, p.tunnel_id AS tunnelId, p.section_id AS sectionId, p.hazard_type AS hazardType, p.item_type AS itemType, p.unit, p.range_min AS rangeMin, p.range_max AS rangeMax, p.scale, p.install_position AS installPosition, p.gateway_code AS gatewayCode, p.protocol, p.collect_freq_sec AS collectFreqSec, p.collect_enabled AS collectEnabled, p.enabled, p.online_status AS onlineStatus, p.last_data_time AS lastDataTime, p.remark FROM mon_point p WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY p.id LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mon_point p WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT p.id, p.point_code AS pointCode, p.point_name AS pointName, p.tunnel_id AS tunnelId, p.section_id AS sectionId, p.hazard_type AS hazardType, p.item_type AS itemType, p.unit, p.range_min AS rangeMin, p.range_max AS rangeMax, p.scale, p.install_position AS installPosition, p.gateway_code AS gatewayCode, p.protocol, p.collect_freq_sec AS collectFreqSec, p.collect_enabled AS collectEnabled, p.enabled, p.online_status AS onlineStatus, p.last_data_time AS lastDataTime, p.remark FROM mon_point p WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.is_deleted = 0
SELECT ts_minute AS ts, avg_value AS value, 0 AS quality FROM data_sample_minute WHERE point_id = #{pointId} AND ts_minute >= #{fromTs} AND ts_minute <= #{toTs} ORDER BY ts_minute ASC

(SELECT ts, value, quality FROM data_sample WHERE point_id = #{pointId} AND ts >= #{fromTs} AND ts <= #{toTs} ORDER BY ts ASC LIMIT 1) UNION ALL (SELECT ts, value, quality FROM data_sample WHERE point_id = #{pointId} AND ts >= #{fromTs} AND ts <= #{toTs} ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1)

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mon_point p WHERE p.is_deleted = 0 AND p.enabled = 1 AND 1=0
AND p.${scope.column} IN #{p2} ) AS totalPoints, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mon_point p WHERE p.is_deleted = 0 AND p.enabled = 1 AND 1=0
AND p.${scope.column} IN #{p3} AND p.online_status = 1) AS onlinePoints, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM data_sample s JOIN mon_point p ON p.id = s.point_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND 1=0
AND p.${scope.column} IN #{p4}
WHERE s.ts >= #{todayStart}) AS todaySamples
